lines.en: A string of wax trails behind me.
I shuffle forward on my little flame.
My wax sways and the flame sways too.

lines.zh: 我跟着魔导士的影子走
lines.en: I follow the mage's shadow.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下一小滴蜡
lines.en: Each step leaves a drop of wax.
As long as the flame burns, I don't stop.
I go slowly, afraid of scorching grass.
My flame tilts as if dozing.
I walk around the puddles.
A candle has no feet; I can only shuffle.
I move toward where the air stirs.
Too far away and my flame shrinks.
I burn, quietly.
My wax has gone a little soft.
My flame stands straight up.
I stare into my own fire.
This room is a touch damp.
I wait for someone to trim me.
The wick has blackened.
I don't speak; I only glow.
When wind comes, I guard the flame.
The wax has hardened into a bead.
I left a mark on the floor.
In this room, only I give light.
There's a fleck of blue in my flame.
I can burn a long while yet.
Stillness is when I'm warmest.
Don't blow me out; I fear the dark.
Come that close and you'll singe.
Is my light enough for you?

lines.zh: 你身上有灵魂熔炉的味道
lines.en: You smell of the soul furnace.
I'm no ordinary candle.
Do you have any wish?
My fire never harms my master.
I know a mage's scent.
Don't blow at me with your mouth.
Is there fire in your hand?
I'll light you; you walk on.
My wax is running low.
Will you take me along?

lines.zh: 我亮着，就说明我还活着
lines.en: My light means I'm still alive.
I look best in shadow.
My little flame wavered.
A piece of wax fell off me.
Only a stub of wax is left
My wick snapped in half.
Not the flame; the wax.
I've suddenly gotten shorter.
The room dimmed a little.
I can still glow.
Smaller, but still burning.
That cost me a lot of wax.
That's not wax; don't feed me.
I take only wax, nothing else.
What you hold is too cold.
Come closer; let me light it.
I'm not hungry; I only want to burn.
This wick still has use.
Try passing me the wax.
I smell oil.
That isn't meant for me.
I follow flame, not food.
Careful; I'm very hot.
You touched my wax.
My flame wobbled.
Don't bump me; I might go out.
I'm far more fragile than you.
There's a dent in my wax.
Sorry, I can't move quickly.
Let's each give a little.
I brushed your clothes.
Once more and I'll topple.
Candles don't do such things.
I only burn; I don't beget.
Find another candle.
My heart is flame, nothing more.
Flame on flame only burns brighter.
Let me burn beside you one night.
I can't make sense of that.
There's not enough wax for two.
I know only one master.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，火就旺了
lines.en: Side by side, our flames grow strong.
Easy; the wax will snap.
I'm hot; wrap your hand.
Don't squeeze my middle.
I'll light the way for you.
Keep the flame off my face.
I'll drip wax on your hand.
My flame will die held like this.
Put me down; I'll shuffle myself.
Hold your hand steadier.
I'll last until you're home.
Who's moving in the dark?
My fire has found you.
Stay away from my master.
I stand here as a shield.
Your shadow is wrong.
I'll take the blow for him.
Small as it is, my flame still burns.
One more step and I lunge.
I'm no warrior, but I don't retreat.
You won't pass this lamp.
My light is the warning.
I keep watch tonight.
I'm watching your shadow.
My flame leans toward you.
You move and my wax trembles.
My light leaves you nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我烧不了多远，但够到门口
lines.en: I can't burn far, just to the door.
My master hasn't woken yet.
I'm counting your steps.
Each drip of wax marks the floor.
You've stepped in my wax.
Don't think I fear fire.
I outlast most flames.
Don't take that last step.
I stand in the doorway.
Let me singe you once.
I fling my flame at you.
That burned, didn't it?
Don't swat it; it'll splash.
My fire knows who to burn.
It only hurts for a moment.
Back off; I guard my master.
Even wax can strike.
That caught your sleeve.
I can't burn you long.
The candle has limbs now.
The soul furnace lit me.
I opened my eyes to fire alone.
My master hasn't come yet.
I shifted across the floor.
This wick finally caught.
The room is a little brighter.
Who should I follow?
My wax is still warm.
I wait to be claimed.

lines.zh: 炉火里出来的东西都会走
lines.en: Things come out of the furnace walking.
This flame won't go out on its own.

lines.zh: 我闻到了魔导士的味道
lines.en: I smell a mage.
From today I take his blows.
My flame is fighting it.
The fall cracked my wax.
The water nearly put me out.
The blast flipped me; the flame held.
The arrowhead sank into my wax.
The spell pressed my flame down.
Without wax, I can barely burn.
That light was brighter than mine.
The dark swallowed half my flame.
